mentions.name: tabularis
mentions.description: This is a lightweight desktop database management tool that provides a modern interface for managing MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite databases through a native desktop application. It is built with Tauri v2 (Rust backend) and React 19 (TypeScript frontend), offering native performance with the flexibility of web technologies.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on tabularis, a lightweight desktop database management tool designed for developers. It provides a modern interface for managing MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite databases through a native desktop application.
